description.narrative: The New Democracy Fund aims at promoting an independent, diverse, resilient and responsive civil society in the Eastern Neighbourhood countries by promoting a culture of democracy and human rights and engaging in regional networking and peer-to-peer exchange of experiences amongst civil society actors. The Danish civil society partners involved are mainly working within youth, media, culture, labour market, green transition, and gender. The expected outcome is to promote democracy and strengthen civil society within the Eastern Neighbourhood countries and across the region.
